HEALTH CONTENT CHECK
A free checklist for anyone writing health information for patients or the public.

Version 1.0, 2 September 2026


WHAT IS IN THIS FOLDER

  Install-in-Claude.pdf     Follow this if you use Claude. About 5 minutes.
  Install-in-ChatGPT.pdf    Follow this if you use ChatGPT. About 5 minutes.
  health-content-check.zip  The checklist itself. Open the PDF first, it tells
                            you what to do with this file.

Pick the PDF that matches the tool you already use. You do not need both.


WHAT IT DOES

It checks a page you have written and tells you what to fix, with the fixes
written out for you. It also works the other way round, as the checklist to
write against before you start.

It is built on free, public standards: the NHS digital service manual standard
for creating health content, and the 10 published PIF TICK criteria.


WHAT IT IS NOT

It is not certification. It gives you no badge, tick or logo, and it is not run
or endorsed by NHS England or by the Patient Information Forum.

Quality marks are awarded by schemes that assess how you produce content over
time, not by anything that looks at a single page. If you want one, apply to
the scheme.

What you can honestly say about content that passes this check is that it is
written to the NHS standard for creating health content.


THE PART PEOPLE SKIP

Most of what makes health information trustworthy cannot be checked by
software: whether a real patient understood it, whether a qualified person
confirmed it is safe, whether anyone reads the feedback, whether the review
date is honoured. The checklist will always hand you a short list of things
only you can confirm, and it will not tick them for you. That list is the
point of the whole thing, not an omission.
